en: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.
Now we're making progress!
I will consider what you have told me.
Only the blood of an innocent can quench Aku'mai's hunger.
The spirits guide our steps as we follow our paths though life, how may I guide yours?
Hm...it is good that you brought this to me, $n.
%s begins searching through his pack...
And finally the candle... to burn those who would thwart you!
I have no time for interruptions.
The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth.  Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague.  We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.
There we go, all finished.  The journal has been translated for you.
With Algernon to keep me supplied, I can do all my work here without hunting for a single herb. If I never have to see the wonders of nature again, it won't be too soon.
Hey, my pockets were picked!
My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $n?
I'm the new king?  What are you talking about?
I seek more training in the priestly ways.
KNOW NO FEAR, SOLDIERS! WE DIE FOR KALIMDOR TODAY!
You seek to draw the General of the Frostwolf legion out from his fortress? PREPOSTEROUS!
Greetings.  I'm a gnome mage trainer, and you're a mage.
Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!
I really envy you, $n. You do amazing work.
Look alive, lads!  The enemy has been sighted!  Form ranks immediately!
Hmmmm... That one clipped it's shoulder. Grumlar was right, the sights are slightly off. Easy enough for me to fix though.
Death to Stormpike!
We're under attack!  A vast, ye swabs! Repel the invaders!
It's here!  The Darkmoon Faire is now open for business!  Be sure to see the most exciting show on all of Azeroth!
%s begins to dance.
Can't you see I'm fishing here!
Yep, you looking for Christopher Drakul in Trade Quarter.  He on eastern platform.
%s transforms the items into a totem.

Located in Dun Morogh, Gnomeregan has been the gnomes' capital city for generations, though it was recently infested by mutant troggs. In a desperate attempt to retaliate, High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered the emergency venting of the city's radioactive waste tanks. Though the troggs became irradiated, their siege continued unabated and the gnomes were forced to seek refuge in the dwarven city of Ironforge, where the High Tinker now enlists brave souls to help his people reclaim their beloved city.
Here, I'd like to give you this token of my love.
Ready when you are, warrior.
Ok, let's get going!
I got worm guts on my shoes.
Good riddance!
I see that you have found the eye.$B$B<Master Ryson grins.>$B$BWell, give it to me!
Little goblin on top of building north of Ruins of Lordaeron.  Leave Undercity and you go there.

All of the food and war materiel we gathered is on its way to Silithus. It should be there in less than $2113w days. Someone told me that once it's all assembled over near Cenarion Hold, someone's going to have to go ring the gong at the Scarab Dais to open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj and start the war.
